home.title: Read the law as it stood on any day
home.lead: Pick a provision and move through time: see its wording on a date, the law that wrote each word, and what changed. Everything is read from this clone, offline.
home.none: No corpus is checked out yet. Choose a country to see the command that adds it, for example:
home.footer: Law text comes from each country's official publisher, in its own language. The notes on each record's limits come from the engine and are in English.

history.in-force.help: Every version, dated the day it took effect, credited to the law that made it.
history.replayed.help: Earlier versions rebuilt by applying each amending law to the text.
history.as-enacted.help: Each law as first published; later amendments are not merged into it.
history.current-only.help: The source keeps only today's consolidated text, so earlier wordings and who wrote each word are not known.
history.metadata-only.help: Catalogue entries without the law's text.
history.unknown.help: This corpus describes itself once it is checked out; until then its kind of history is not known here.
